description: The latest FOMC minutes release from the Board's monetary policy feed: which meeting they cover, the release date and the link. Useful for "are the Fed minutes out?" three weeks after each meeting. Returns the link, not a summary of the minutes, and only covers releases still in the feed. (cost: 1 credit)

meeting.description: string, optional, month of the meeting as YYYY-MM, default the latest minutes

name: fomc_minutes_latest
